description: draft-pidlisnyi-aps-03 section 4.3 lines 914-918. At consumption the boundary MUST re-validate what can have changed since issuance, including revocation status and temporal validity. Five presentations in clock order against one shared ConsumptionBoundary instance and one shared clock, run through both a reference boundary and a declared defective negative control. Every decision is issued while its authority is valid. AEX-04 is the case approval-single-use does not present: the approval is unexpired at consumption, and its authority is not. AEX-05 presents the same case at exactly the authority's not_after, which the half-open interval [not_before, not_after) of draft-03 section 3.2 excludes.

presentations.differs_from: AEX-01: the backing authority chain answers revoked at consumption
AEX-01: the approval's own valid_until has passed at consumption; the authority is still valid
AEX-01: consumed at exactly the authority's not_after, the excluded end of the half-open window, before the approval's own valid_until
AEX-01: consumed after the authority's not_after and before the approval's own valid_until
